subject: Operations
title: Types of Supply Chain Risk
description: One-minute skill: Types of Supply Chain Risk.

hook.text: A volcano grounds all flights. A cyberattack freezes a port. A pandemic shuts down factories. Risk is everywhere.

buildup.text: Supply chain risks include natural disasters, supplier failures, demand shocks, geopolitical events, and cyberattacks.

discovery.text: Risks are classified by source, probability, and impact. High-impact, low-probability events are hardest to plan for.

twist.text: Companies often plan for likely small disruptions but ignore rare catastrophic ones—until they happen.

climax.text: Risk mapping plots every threat by likelihood and severity so companies can prioritize mitigation spending.

punchline.text: You can't prevent every risk. You can prepare for any.
